smoke.expr: (async () => { const v = await window.aibox.access.explain({ tool: 'viddl_inspect' }); if (v && v.allowed) return 'tool granted — the device suite covers the live path'; const t = document.body.innerText; if (!t.includes('解析能力不可用')) throw new Error('tool blocked but the applet never explained why'); if (/没有装视频下载模块/.test(t)) throw new Error('regression: the old message asserts the module is missing, but the host cannot tell that apart from a disabled tool switch'); return 'blocked and explained honestly' })()

queue.expr: (async () => { const items = await window.aibox.download.list({}); return 'queue readable: ' + items.length + ' rows' })()

device.expr: (async () => { const v = await window.aibox.access.explain({ tool: 'viddl_inspect' }); if (!v || !v.allowed) throw new Error('viddl_inspect not granted: ' + JSON.stringify(v)); return 'extractor reachable' })()
(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().includes('添加')); if (!b) throw new Error('add entry point missing'); b.click(); return 'opened' })()

(async () => { const r = await window.aibox.tools.call({ name: 'viddl_jobs', arguments: { action: 'list' } }); if (!r || r.isError) throw new Error('viddl_jobs list failed: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return 'library reachable' })()
